verdict.rationale: Formant documents remote, real-time visibility into deployed robots. It offers real-time telemetry and status updates across the fleet, a WebRTC peer-to-peer live connection, and agent-configured data streams from ROS devices that feed an Observe view and realtime visualizations. Debugging aids include the `formant.get_file` and `formant.run_script` commands and forwarding an on-device web page or port to your machine. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a live ROS topic browser/inspector, explicit remote log viewing or streaming (only file retrieval is shown), independent or hands-on corroboration.
